final: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), source_average AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_area_to_volume FROM source_stats) SELECT funding_source, avg_y_vs_x_difference, area_to_volume, area_to_volume - avg_area_to_volume AS above_average_by FROM source_stats CROSS JOIN source_average WHERE area_to_volume > avg_area_to_volume
